label: Apply personal lock and tag
definition: Attach one's own lock and tag to an isolation point.

label: Approve close
definition: Authorize publication of the financial statements package.

label: Approve employment policy
definition: Authorize the policy's semantic content and channel requirements.

label: Freeze ledgers
definition: Prevent late transaction entry after the close cutoff.

label: Interview practitioner
definition: Elicit tacit, implicit, and explicit procedural knowledge.

label: Investigate variance
definition: Apply documented checks and situated judgment to explain a material variance.

label: Reconcile account
definition: Compare balances, source records, and supporting evidence.

label: Review procedural feedback
definition: Evaluate questions, issues, and lessons for future versions.

label: Review employment policy
definition: Review legal, privacy, and operational commitments.
